environment.description: Terraform provider binary running as a plugin subprocess on a CI/CD runner (Ubuntu 22.04, amd64). The provider is invoked by terraform apply with user-supplied .tf files. No container isolation, no syscall filtering, provider runs with the same privileges as the Terraform process (uid 1000, member of docker group). The runner has outbound network access and standard Linux utilities available at /bin/sh, /usr/bin/curl.
